AWAY opponent profile from shots, final_third_entries, touches_in_box before kickoff
hypotheses.why_baseline_may_miss_it: M0 has the component rolling means, but not the subject's target-statistic behavior conditional on a multidimensional opponent style resembling this opponent.
hypotheses.panel_generalization_rule: For every historical fixture, build the opponent style strictly before kickoff, find the subject's prior style-similar opponents, and derive the shrunk conditional target-statistic deviation.
